verdict.rationale: Nix advertises a very large repository of over 140,000 packages (nixpkgs). It documents installing from it (`nix-env --attr nixpkgs.some-package`), searching it (`nix search`) and using it on demand (`nix-shell`, `nix run`), with pre-built binaries served from a binary cache. One community comment notes that wrapping packages yourself is costly, which hints that anything outside the repository takes extra effort. missing for 10: evidence that the repository is actively maintained (update cadence, contributors), independent corroboration of how broad and fresh the packages are.
